```json
{ "drag": false, "wheel": false, "pinch": true }
```

I worked out the answer from `camera-notes.md` only, since I can't check the library itself. Without a scene, drags and wheel only add to inertial offsets that are never applied, so `alpha`, `beta` and `radius` stay put. A two-finger pinch writes `radius` directly, so it changes. I could not write the file to disk because I have no file-writing tool here, so the content above needs saving to `app/notes/preview-controls.json`. I'm also relying on the notes being accurate for version 1.39.0, and I didn't check how a one-finger touch drag behaves on the tablet.
